name: Cassian & Azriel
story: Brothers, roommates, and full-time troublemakers. Cassian has claimed every slipper in the house as a chew toy, teeth marks included. Azriel collects belly rubs as a toll, and skipping payment earns you a smack. Double the tabby, double the attitude.

name: Maxxy
story: Maxxy, resident cuddle expert for 15 wonderful years. Loved: laying in arms, face rubs, being a very good boy. Hated: bath time. Missed: every single day.

name: Mango
story: Born in the Rocky Mountains of Colorado, Mango is toilet trained.  He makes sure to wake me up every night to demand a treat after using the toilet.

name: Ollie Ray
story: Doesn't like people hugging each other.

name: The Crew
story: Agent Six is a six-toed beauty who chills hard after a long day of sleeping and playing. Lon does catalog modeling gigs for extra cash and treats. Mito loves festive accessories and barked at my husband for six months straight like he was a stranger. And Vegas? A silent-judging deep thinker, contemplating life and her place in it.

name: Sarge Lamont J Faithful
story: He prefers dirt facials over soap and water. He spends his days snoring in Mom's office, guarding the house, and trying to play with his outside friends — the ones in the trees and under the ground. They watch him through the windows, but scatter the second he comes out. Rude.

name: Lola
story: She identifies as a Doberman.  Despite her short legs, she is bold, confident, and fearless.

name: SinOmen Chea
story: She was toilet trained, loved playing fetch, and long walks on her leash.

name: Diamond Terrance Stribich
story: Diamond is a one-eyed wonder who follows me everywhere. He’s such a good boy.

name: Needles
story: Rescued as an abandoned kitten in Panama, Needles was bottle-fed and nursed back to health — and the bond was so strong she flew home to the U.S. with her mom. Now she's a healthy, happy tuxedo cat with one rule: bedtime means snuggling under the covers, no exceptions.

name: Doodle
story: Very nosy. He loves the tea!

name: Harlequin
story: The necklace she’s wearing is made from her very own teeth!

name: Mia
story: Adopted in July 2023, she's been my comfort, my companion, and my whole world. She's a mellow girl who loves every human she meets. Other dogs? Not so much.

name: Kash & Karter
story: Kash, a 5-year-old Russian Blue rescue, is too smart for his own good. He opens doors, mimics words, and argues about everything. Karter, 3, is a lovable velcro pup who guards like a rottweiler and snuggles like a teddy bear. They bicker like cats and dogs, but as the photos show, they're besties by the end of it.

name: Miso
story: My late fiancé and I adopted him in November 2024. He may have some anxiety, but he's the sweetest, clingiest boy. He'll wait right by the shower until you're out and meows up a storm when he's hungry.

name: Penny
story: Penny is an absolute sassy queen. She can spot the weakest link in any group and will loudly beg for food until you cave. Say no, and you'll get the stare of disappointment (see photo) and a sudden urge to question every life choice that brought you here.

name: Rocky Rode
story: Meet Rocky Rode, aka Rockstar. She's not chasing squirrels, she's trying to enroll in their Tree Climbing Masterclass. When she's not doing that, she's balancing her chakras and sniffing seaweed at the beach. But make no mistake: zen is temporary, and being a Michigan Wolverine fan is forever. Go Blue!

name: Choco
story: Choco was the sweetest and most loving. He would attach to you like glue. He loved being around people and his favorite playmates, kids! He is missed greatly!

name: Tonchi
story: Tonchi is a rebel without a cause! His fighter spirit won't let him be a house cat, so he is the neighborhood cat that everyone knows. He loves going from house to house acting like he hasn't eaten and taking advantage of all the love. He has won over 4 different neighbors and so he'll be seen chilling at one of his houses, but he always comes back home to me.

name: Yogi
story: The best cat to ever walk the planet, no debate. Yogi fetched like a dog and served as the household's toughest music critic. If you sang, you got bit.

name: Cookie & Coconut
story: Cookie (left) and Coconut (right) were bonded bunnies and the sweetest little pair. Coconut was the brave one; Cookie was his shy but mischievous shadow. They've both crossed the Rainbow Bridge and are back together now, eating endless bananas, their favorite treat. Forever my fur babies. <3

name: Fifteen
story: She got bully by the neighborhood cat 😢

name: Bash & Ted
story: Bash the Lab, 5, enforces a strict house rule: when he naps, everyone naps. His brother Ted the Golden, also 5, curates an impressive rubber duckie collection, and no, they are not chew toys.

name: Max
story: He would yell if his food bowl was not full at all times!

name: Zoey
story: Ball is life!

name: The Queens of Chaos
story: When these three aren’t busy wreaking havoc through the house with their zoomies and vocal demands, they can often be found sun bathing. Or as we call “grilling” in the sun.

name: Harper
story: Adopted into the family at the age of 3 months.  She loves playing outside and chasing squirrels as much as she can. She also loves watching basketball on TV with the family and riding in the back seat of the our 1992 Volvo 240.

name: Fitzgerald & Miklos
story: Fitzgerald: cuddle bug, lazy potato, and dangerously food motivated. Do not say "Who's that guy?" His brofur Miklos spins when he's excited, chats up a storm every morning, and takes treats like a gentleman. Fitzgerald takes them like a shark.

name: Ted
story: He likes to be involved in everything I'm doing, especially if it is a job that requires 0 pugs! Ted's favorite things are going on hikes/long walks, getting zoomies on the beach, and getting a pup cup on every car-ride.

name: Vegas
story: Vegas loves butt scratches and In-N-Out meat patties

name: Spinach
story: Spinach Killua Carla Jr. (he goes by Spin or Spinach). He mastered booping and smooshing his nose at the age of 2. Knows how to smile. Looks scary but he is actually the biggest baby. He enjoys cuddling, the dog park, and running along side his mom when she’s biking.

name: Magnus
story: Master Manipulator - During dinnertime, he goes from parent to parent, acting like he's never been fed before.

name: MIDI & Cubbers
story: Meet MIDI (the torti) and Cubbers (the tuxedo), just 3 months and 2 months old in this picture. MIDI is the adventurer of the two, taking harness walks on the beach and hanging out on lifeguard towers. Cubbs prefers a quieter life at home, ideally with snacks.

name: Orangy
story: He is a food-motivated gentle giant. Loves cuddling and freeze-dried minnows.
